visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 final portable/source-terrain frames, including the 1024x640 summary. The individual warm-stone church has recessed cross arms, polygonal corner volumes, a faceted drum with narrow arched lights, a ribbed stone cone and cross, lower western narthex and northeast annex. The southern entrance has a deep lower portal, open upper front/side arches and a six-column bell pavilion with a pointed cap. Broad frieze/eyebrow rhythm and sparse medallion/cross reliefs are geometric abstractions. Corrected the overfilled main body, cone soffit gap, unsupported pavilion floor, hidden lower western light and excessive south roof height behind the pavilion. Lowered estimated south roof now leaves the pavilion air visible above it. Fine narrative carvings and hidden joins remain approximate.
